judgment.rationale: Both are Class X Indicators (rank 1) under the same CLO78 'Draws labelled diagrams for various concepts of light' and Chapter 'Human eye and colourful world', so the grain and framing match. C176 requires drawing a labelled diagram of refraction across a single media interface; C179 requires drawing and labelling composite ray diagrams for white light dispersing through a prism, recombination through an inverted prism, and rainbow formation.
